name: Onboard Automation Bridge
description: Service-agnostic browser automation proxy. Executes commands from any backend worker over a resilient WebSocket + HTTP-fallback protocol. Built-in activatable debugging (HAR capture, console mirror, network/trace recording, DOM snapshot).

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self'; connect-src wss: https: http: ws:
